title: Iran sets 'preconditions' ahead of ceasefire talks as Vance warns Tehran not to 'play' US
summary: Iranian and US delegations headed for Islamabad on Friday ahead of ceasefire negotiations between the two countries that threaten to be derailed by deep disagreements. While Iran said it would only begin talks if ‌Washington accepted its "preconditions", Vice President JD Vance warned Tehran not to "play" the US.
